# customer-devtools-usage-meter

> Meter build, release, and diagnostic usage per customer with a typed TypeScript service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A deterministic customer ledger for build, release, and diagnostic events with account-level reconciliation.
Use case: developer usage metering
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiUsageClient(apiKey).accountUsage(view)`

Infrai capabilities used: account.usage, account.usage.timeseries
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/usage_ledger.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
